courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鐵路橋軌相互作用分析
related.transfer: 可遷移「單質量固有頻率」與「接觸卸載比例」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鐵路橋軌相互作用分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Single-mass natural frequency" and "Contact unloading fraction" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rail–bridge interaction analysis must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦車軌接觸模態耦合取樣與穩定性；鐵路橋軌相互作用分析則以橋梁溫伸制動位移與鋼軌約束為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on vehicle-track contact modal coupling sampling and stability; Rail–bridge interaction analysis centres on bridge thermal movement braking displacement and rail restraint, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「單質量固有頻率」與「橋梁自由熱伸長」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鐵路橋軌相互作用分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「橋端轉角位移」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Single-mass natural frequency” and “Bridge free thermal movement”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rail–bridge interaction analysis, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Bridge-end rotation movement", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

把本課算例的一個假設移到軌道旁儲能系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「往返效率」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Single-mass natural frequency” and “Train kinetic-energy ceiling”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Wayside energy-storage systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

courses.summaryEn: Coupled vehicle–track vibration analysis: Vehicle-track contact modal coupling sampling and stability.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 列車—軌道耦合振動分析
history.text: 本課把列車—軌道耦合振動分析放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。車輛與軌道透過輪軌接觸互相交換作用力，車體舒適與輪軌力峰值不是同一輸出，模型必須分清質量層次與接觸條件。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Coupled vehicle–track vibration analysis in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Vehicle and track exchange forces through wheel contact; carbody comfort and peak contact force are different outputs, and the model must distinguish mass levels and contact conditions. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「單質量固有頻率」到「輸出頻譜解析度」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Single-mass natural frequency" through "Output spectral resolution" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
